findings.message: 13 of 13 footage events carry one reviewed video asset, no stills, no duplicate clip identity. audit_asset_manifest and the durable workspace check both report clean.

Two events could not be served literally within the bounded search: ev-4 (543 people) is a celebration crowd rather than a street crowd, and ev-10 is a lone phone on a table rather than a phone face-down. Both are recorded with fallback_reason instead of being passed off as literal.

The opening hook shot was re-sourced after the first pass returned a close-up whose subject filled every serviceable type band; the selected clip leaves the upper band plain wall, which is what the Film Type hook needs.
The retry pass budget (1) was fully spent, so no further sourcing was possible; the remaining repairs were made by reconciling the plan to the footage actually on disk rather than by buying more.
All footage is Pexels; Pixabay video returned nothing usable for these queries in either pass.
